svg.title: A mixture family of two fixed Gaussians
svg.desc: Three panels for mixing weight 0.1, 0.5 and 0.9 showing the two weighted components and their sum, plus the Fisher metric along the mixing weight on a log scale.
svg.text: A mixture family: p(x; η) = (1−η)·p₀(x) + η·p₁(x), with p₀ = N(−1.5, 1) and p₁ = N(1.5, 1) fixed
It is smallest in the middle and large near
the ends, where a small step in η adds mass
in a region the other ingredient barely covers.
